purpose: Pilot: can the response phase structure found in A0M (common-mode rho = |mean(h)|/std(h) decaying ~8-10x across training phases) guide a training policy? NOT a final algorithm. Mechanism pilot only.

frozen_science_semantics.response: production run_adjoint_only on event snapshot, H=4, M=4, hvp_fp32=True (formula/code UNCHANGED); raw hhat j=1..4 (dV_score/dlambda, negative=beneficial); candidate batches/events REUSED from A0K frozen K10 manifest (read-only)
frozen_science_semantics.phase_metric: rho(t) = abs(mean(h_1..h_4)) / (std(h_1..h_4) + 1e-12); population std (ddof=0), same as A0M diagnostic

phase_policy.high: rho > 2            -> action = no-op (native AdamW step, no injection)
phase_policy.medium: 1 <= rho <= 2    -> action = inject g + lambda*(g_j* - g), j* = argmin_{j in 1..4} hhat_j, tie -> smallest id
phase_policy.low: rho < 1             -> action = no-op (native AdamW step, no injection)

frozen_science_semantics.injection: A0K-frozen semantics: single-step post-unscale/pre-clip gradient assignment p.grad = g + 0.05*(g_j - g); lambda=0.05 UNCHANGED; chosen==0 assigns native gradient clones (bitwise = no intervention)

frozen_environment.recipe: e3c v0.7 identical to A0K/A0L: hidden 256x4, seq 128, batch 4, accum 2, bf16, clip 1.0, lr 5e-4, planned 128 optimizer steps
frozen_environment.events_source: A0K live_manifest.json K10 events (sha256 below), read-only
frozen_environment.eval: v_score(64)/v_eval(64) frozen validation_split, every 10 steps + final (A0K/A0L identical)

arms.B: fixed-j1: inject j=1 at EVERY event (A0K arm-B semantics; adjoint not computed, blind injection)
arms.C: phase-aware scheduler: at every event compute h_j + rho, act per frozen phase policy
arms.A_wc: arm A under T_C wall budget (equal wall-clock)
arms.B_wc: arm B under T_C wall budget (equal wall-clock)

equal_wall_clock_protocol: T_C = measured wall of C full 128-step run in-session (all controller overhead included); A_wc/B_wc consume T_C in the same session

consistency_gates.S1: arm A(2031) model_hash bitwise == v0.7 bank at steps 46/52 (native path identity)
consistency_gates.S2: C-ghost (full phase machinery incl. adjoint + rho, forced action=0 at all events) trajectory bitwise == arm A
consistency_gates.POST_MAIN: A/B final_v_eval bitwise == frozen A0K K10 A/B summaries for seeds 2030-2032

must_save: phase trajectory (per event: step, phase, rho)
final v_eval per arm per seed
metrics: gain vs AdamW = L_A - L_C (equal steps @128)
equal-wall-clock gains L_A_wc - L_C, L_B_wc - L_C (with steps-completed check)
controller overhead = sum(controller_compute_time)/wall + T_extra = T_C - T_A
phase occupancy = fraction of events in high/medium/low per seed

interpretation_cases_frozen.CASE_A: median(L_B - L_C) > 0 AND >=2/3 seeds positive  -> phase scheduling effective (C beats B)
interpretation_cases_frozen.CASE_C: median(L_A - L_C) < 0 AND median(L_B - L_C) < 0 -> stop phase route
interpretation_cases_frozen.CASE_B: otherwise (incl. C~B) -> response mainly rediscovers fixed strategy

stop_condition: pilot only; report and stop; no expansion, no optimizer/lambda changes
